description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect form 19.06.2023 to 25.06.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for financial/compliance requirements related to international trade, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes. The mention of the Director General serves only to identify the authority making the regulatory determination, not as a personnel announcement.
